decision: Create a local preservation and analysis export, but do not commit, upload or publish the combined data archive without establishing upstream permission. No blanket CC BY or CC0 grant is made.

clarifications: This notice does not claim copyright over unprotectable facts or restrict existing public-domain rights, statutory exceptions or valid upstream permissions.
Local export capability is not a legal opinion or a grant of any rights absent from upstream sources.
Source-specific rights remain separate; this notice does not revoke a valid upstream CC0 dedication.
This decision does not change the license status of existing repository code or documentation.
The SQL data export does not include raw PDFs, images, access tokens, connection credentials or database permissions.

The optional rider profile catalog is separate from the SQL export. Official image URLs are unapproved references, not a permission grant. Individually reviewed reusable photographs in media_catalog.json retain their separate author dedications or Creative Commons licenses and do not clear official artwork.
